name: SBNA Chat Widget for CCXAI
author: SBNA Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd

sections.description:
Empower your website with AI-driven live chat.
The SBNA Chat Widget for CCXAI is developed by SBNA Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. to help businesses provide real-time, secure customer support via their CCXAI account.

Whether you’re running an e-commerce store, SaaS platform, or service-based business, this widget enables validated, AI-enhanced communication between your visitors and your support agents.

For more information, visit the official website: https://ccxai.com

Key Features:

  • Lightweight, fast-loading chat widget
  • AI-powered message handling via CCXAI
  • Secure chat sessions using your company credentials
  • Easy setup with admin configuration panel
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive design
  • Compatible with all modern WordPress themes

Ideal For:

  • Businesses seeking intelligent support automation
  • Startups needing a live chat tool without third-party dependencies
  • Websites aiming to offer real-time engagement

Integrated Service

This plugin communicates with your CCXAI account to load the chat widget within an iframe. It does not use third-party services.

CCXAI Customer Chat System
– Purpose: Renders a chat interface in an iframe.
– Data Sent: Company name, identifier code, and a unique UUID (LoginUserId). Users may optionally submit name, email, and phone number.
– Data Received: UI and communication interface for live chat.
– When: On chat form submission or restoring session via sessionStorage.
– User Consent: Required via checkbox before chat begins.
– Terms of Service: https://ccxai.com/terms-and-conditions/
– Privacy Policy: https://ccxai.com/privacy-policy/

Contributors & Developers

This plugin is developed and maintained by SBNA Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Website: https://ccxai.com

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ccxai-chat-widget directory, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate it through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > CCXAI Chat Widget.
  4. Enter your Company Name and Identifier Code from your CCXAI dashboard.
  5. Save your settings. The chat widget will now appear on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a CCXAI account?

Yes. You must have a registered CCXAI tenant with access to the Customer Chat Service.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is free. CCXAI services may be subject to separate pricing plans.

Can I change the widget style?

Currently, customization requires custom CSS. More styling options will be available in future updates.
